summary: Floor & Decor Holdings, Inc. filed an 8-K to report that its subsidiary entered into a new $200 million senior secured term loan facility refinancing an existing facility, with Goldman Sachs as agent. The loan matures in seven years, bears interest at SOFR plus 2.00% or base rate plus 1.00%, and is secured by substantially all assets. There is a 1.00% prepayment premium for repricing within six months but no premium thereafter. This is a routine refinancing of credit facilities—a financing activity, not a special situation like an acquisition, divestiture, or activist campaign.
